Pree's ticket is #8841. I posted that as a thread reply to her message in #central-random.

Tobias flagged it for support in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk at the Plains depots, and that he'd raised it on #8841.

One gap: Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I'm treating them as the same account because the Jan 2 Central handoffs digest lists Marrow Fieldworks as the dealer account that changed hands on Jan 5. I told Pree this, and warned her not to confuse it with #88412, the old Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 scanner ticket.

The gbrain search didn't run. The brain refused the request because this bot's access token isn't tied to any member, so nothing was read from it. An admin on the brain host would need to fix that. I found the answer only in channels and public files Pree can see herself.
